notes.title: Wizard's watch is now free to play !
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
It's official : Wizard's watch is free to play !
I hope this will encourage a lot of players to try the game and enjoy its content.
Don't hesitate to tell your friends about it !

Cheers !

notes.title: Wizard's Watch goes Free to play !
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I would like to announce that Wizard's watch is going to be Free to play! I hope that this will encourage new players to try the game. I want to give a special thanks all of you who purchased the game, your support means a lot to me !
I can't wait to see this community grow !

notes.title: Difficulty Update
notes.content:
This patch will include some balance changes for the easy and normal mode.
Easy :
* Phase duration reduced by 10 seconds
* Damage taken reduced by 50%
* Villager HP increased by 50%
Normal :
* Villager HP increased by 50%
